instructions_to_main_agent: Language is strictly Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia) for all customer-facing and tenant admin UI text.

Implement the tenant branding color customizer dynamically using document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--tenant-primary', hex) or CSS custom property bindings so tenants can configure their primary purple/brand tone.

Use Leaflet with react-leaflet or vanilla leaflet script with OpenStreetMap tiles. Provide reliable fallback coordinates centered on Jakarta/Bandung/Surabaya with pre-seeded GeoJSON polygons so the coverage checker works out-of-the-box.

The Customer Flow must be seamless: Clicking CTA opens customer lead dialog (Nama + WA mandatory) -> Navigates/renders the interactive full-screen map -> Mobile fixed center pin UX with Floating Action Button state machine -> Instant ray-casting point-in-polygon test against active GeoJSON -> Displays result modal -> WhatsApp direct link generator pre-filled with customer details, package, coordinates and coverage status.

The Admin Dashboard must have responsive layout with sidebar for: Dashboard (overview metrics), Coverage (GIS upload/preview/toggle active table), Packages (CRUD internet tiers with IDR pricing), Leads (search, filter by status, pagination, export/WhatsApp action), Branding (tenant title, logo upload/preview, primary color picker), and Account/Tenants placeholders.
All interactive elements MUST have the prescribed data-testid tags.
